name: THL statistics
invalid_configuration: Set the entity of a disease from the thl integration.
invalid_height: Invalid height. height and max_height must be positive numbers of pixels, and height_mode auto, fixed or max.
entity_helper: The whole country's sensor of a disease, or of the flu-like illness visits, provided by the thl integration. If you add several to the card, you can switch between them with the buttons at the top of the card.
map_width_helper: Leave empty and the map follows the width of the card.
color_by_helper: Level compares each county with the whole country. Change compares it with its own week before.
color_by_level: Level compared with the whole country
show_trend_helper: A line of the chosen area's past six months with its figures.
default_area_helper: Chosen whenever the card loads. Clicking it again shows the whole country.
key_level: incidence compared with the whole country
key_share: share of visits compared with the whole country
show_inset_helper: The capital region drawn again larger under the figures, so its small counties are easier to choose.
show_key_helper: What the map's colours mean, under the map.
height_mode_helper: A height set in the layout tab of a sections view is used instead.
height_helper: The card is always this tall, and the map shrinks to fit inside it.
max_height_helper: The card grows with its content up to this height, and then the map shrinks to fit.
